summary: GuestAccess enables temporary access for users through a guest invitation mechanism, utilizing a session key passed via query string. The system validates credentials and session expiry, allows login if valid, and displays errors accordingly. The page shows a title with province context, handles login errors, and renders a footer with copyright and version.
purpose: Provide temporary, restricted system access to users via guest invitation links. Enforces session validation and displays contextual information and errors.

business_rules: Guest invitation must not be expired.
Login only allowed if session credentials are valid.
Display province in title if available.
Show error messages for expiry, inactivation, or invalid invitation.
validations: SessionHash (Key) must be present in query string.
Credentials must be found for sessionHash.
calculations: expiryDate compared to current DateTime for session validity.
Formatting expiry date into error message.
conditions: If expiryDate < DateTime.Now, show expiry error.
If Security.LoginEncrypted fails and Inactivated, show expiry error.
If credentials search fails, show invalid invitation error.
system_behavior: Redirects user to start screen if login succeeds.
Shows/hides login error label depending on error state.
Updates page title with province context on PreRender.
Displays footer with copyright and version.
